title: RequirePrimitive
description: Declarative condition evaluation gate for physical commodities and personal actor attributes.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

domain.description: Domain of inspection: COMMODITY checks physical inventory stock; ATTRIBUTE checks actor record metrics.

actor.description: Entity token to evaluate (e.g. ORDER_ACTOR, INITIATOR, or specific entity ID).

metric.description: Commodity token (e.g. CASH, BEER_KEG) or attribute key (e.g. fatigue).

value.description: Static numeric threshold or dynamic symbol (e.g. CALCULATED_TOTAL_COST, PARAM.amount).

error_code.description: Explicit failure code (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, OUT_OF_STOCK, INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCE).

extra_time_spent.description: Operational minutes wasted upon gate bounce.

extra_fatigue.description: Fatigue penalty applied to operative upon gate bounce.

next_step.description: ID of next step on pass, or null to terminate pipeline.
